errors.trigger: No PR URL supplied, or GitHub CLI missing or unauthenticated
errors.diagnosis: The review cannot start without a PR URL and working gh authentication
errors.rescue_action: Halt and show the invocation form plus gh auth login
errors.user_message: No pull request to review. Supply a PR URL and run gh auth login first.

errors.trigger: Snapshot incomplete: unverifiable SHAs, partial diff, or missing needed CI evidence
errors.diagnosis: A verdict requires the full deterministic bundle; partial state is unreviewable
errors.rescue_action: Stop without reviewing and report exactly what is missing
errors.user_message: The PR snapshot is incomplete. Fix collection before reviewing.

errors.trigger: gh, git, or network call fails mid-collection
errors.diagnosis: Collection depends on remote GitHub and git operations that can fail transiently
errors.rescue_action: Halt, show the collector output, and suggest retry or access fix
errors.user_message: Collection failed. Retry, or fix gh and network access first.
